# Test that we can unset variables, even if initially invalid,
# as long as resulting config is valid.

env GKENV=badenv
env GKOS=
env GKARCH=
env GKEXPERIMENT=

! go env
stderr '^gecko: unknown GKEXPERIMENT badexp$'

go env -u GKEXPERIMENT

! go env
stderr '^gecko: unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair bados/badarch$'

! go env -u GKOS
stderr '^gecko: unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair \w+/badarch$'

! go env -u GKARCH
stderr '^gecko: unsupported GKOS/GKARCH pair bados/\w+$'

go env -u GKOS GKARCH

go env

-- badenv --
GKOS=bados
GKARCH=badarch
GKEXPERIMENT=badexp
